Relocated packed stream at handover, byte-identical to the intro-entry image at address minus $15F7. Startup generates the sprite and colour data used here from sources in the unpacked image.

Relocated packed stream at handover, byte-identical to the intro-entry image at address minus $15F7. The game uses this range for runtime graphics and copies the interrupt state and upper sprite seed from the unpacked image.
